gen-gf-underdog-gf-noto-sans-inscription: Noto Sans Inscriptional Pahlavi keeps its small counters wonderfully unclogged. Underdog sets a horseshoe-wide c and curves that never swell, so its commanding display swagger lands against that approachable, contemporary body.
gen-gf-underdog-gf-varta: Bent-pipe-cleaner curves at a single weight, that's Underdog, with a c opened like a horseshoe. Varta follows with big open eyes on every e and a, so paragraphs of text keep an easy, contemporary flow.
gen-gf-underdog-gf-ysabeau-infant: Unshaded, steady outlines and a horseshoe-wide c give Underdog its commanding, expressive look. And Underdog earns its keep big and brief, while Ysabeau Infant adds approachable terminals that flick outward like tongs.
gen-gf-underdog-gf-ysabeau-sc: Underdog glides under the eye like wire, its c opened wide as a horseshoe and its curves never swelling. Make Underdog small and Ysabeau SC, with its gaping c, quietly takes over.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-cal-sans: Unica One is all daylight and single-stroke strength. Cal Sans takes over below with short ascenders, one stroke width throughout and a tall x-height, so the two sit together smoothly.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-carlito: Carlito reads clearly at small sizes, its round letters open and its spacing tight like thread wound on a spool. Under Unica One, Carlito paragraphs move along with a steady, tight rhythm.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-farro: Unica One is all open curves and one steady thickness. It makes the commanding display moment, while Farro, with compressed ascenders and zero stroke contrast, simply keeps text approachable and tidy.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-winky-rough: Pipe-cleaner letterforms with a huge lowercase eye: that's Unica One. Winky Rough is a sans with a body height nearly matching the capitals, and that tightness is what sets the pair apart.
gen-gf-unkempt-fs-hind: Rough-hewn and expressive, Unkempt gives its t a matching crossbar and stem, with gaps that keep c open. Big, short lines suit it; Hind, a plain sans, covers the rest.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-alan-sans: Unkempt gives its t a crossbar and stem of matching weight, and its curves have no pressure swells at all. Alan Sans holds its curve tails well back, a modern, tidy foil.
